record.decision_reason: General conformal causal-inference theory with a substantive medical application focus. Intro frames clinical dosing uncertainty; the only actual real-world domain is MIMIC-III 14,719 critical-care patients, modeling blood pressure against mechanical-ventilation duration and examining four patient-specific interval curves (§5.1/5.3).
